method: perchance.org and most lane hosts were unreachable by the fetch tool from this container (DNS), so features come from web search results, community docs (perchance fandom wiki, lemmy guides, reimplementations on GitHub) and prior knowledge of the sites; a builder should confirm details flagged 'reported' on the live site.

features.name: Plain lists
features.detail: A generator is named lists, one item per line; [listName] pulls a random item from a list.

features.name: Odds / weights ^
features.detail: item ^3, fractional ^1/10, and dynamic odds ^[condition] change how often an item is picked.

features.name: Inline choices {a|b|c}
features.detail: Inline random choice inside an item, weighted options allowed.

features.name: Ranges {1-10} {a-z}
features.detail: Random number or letter range inline.

features.name: Smart article {a} and plural {s}
features.detail: {a} becomes a/an from the next word; {s} pluralises by the preceding number.
features.verse_evidence: {a}/{A} and {s} by the number before it (lib/listgen.js) (2026-10-25)

features.name: Hierarchical / nested lists
features.detail: Indented sublists, dot navigation [animal.mammal], dynamic navigation [names[gender]].

features.name: Methods: selectOne/selectMany/selectUnique/selectAll/joinItems
features.detail: [list.selectUnique(3).joinItems(', ')] etc.

features.name: consumableList
features.detail: A copy of a list that removes each pick so nothing repeats until exhausted (deck-of-cards draws).
features.verse_evidence: [d = list.consumableList, ""] then [d]; starts over when used up (2026-10-25)

features.name: Text transforms
features.detail: titleCase, sentenceCase, upperCase, lowerCase, pluralForm, singularForm, pastTense/presentTense/futureTense, possessiveForm, negativeForm.
features.verse_evidence: titleCase, sentenceCase, upperCase, lowerCase, pluralForm, singularForm, possessiveForm, pastTense, presentTense, futureTense, negativeForm (2026-10-25)

features.name: Variables, assignment and logic
features.detail: [x = animal] stores a pick; if/else, ternaries, &&/||, arithmetic, repeat(n), evaluateItem.
features.verse_evidence: [x = list], if / else if / else, a ? b : c, == != < > && || !, + - * / % (parsed, never run as JavaScript) (2026-10-25)

features.name: $output and $meta
features.detail: $output names the root list; $meta sets title, description, image for the page/social card.

union_gaps: A real list language for 'make your own': named lists, [references], ^weights, {a|b}, {1-10}, {a}/{s}, nested lists, methods (selectUnique, joinItems), consumableList (perchance.org; perchance-lib/perhaps reimplement it)
Publish and share a user-made generator at its own link, with remix/fork and embed (perchance.org)
A full text-to-image page: description + negative prompt, art-style menu, shape, image count, seed, download, local and public gallery (perchance.org ai-text-to-image-generator)
Comments/chat under each generator with owner moderation (perchance.org comments-plugin)
Per-generator options: gender/variant toggles, culture/usage, genre, archetype (fantasynamegenerators, behindthename, reedsy, namegenerator, seventhsanctum)
AI character chat and AI story tools: character editor, threads, regenerate/edit, lore/memory, import/export, share link (perchance.org ai-character-chat, ai-chat)
Scale and discovery: hundreds of generators by category with search and a random-generator button (fantasynamegenerators 1,400+, springhole 1,200+, seventhsanctum, perchance hub)
Structured multi-field outputs: NPC cards, taverns, loot, dungeons, plus a dice roller (dungeonmastersvault, chaoticshiny, perchance dice-plugin)
Lore/meaning text per generator and name meanings/etymology (fantasynamegenerators, behindthename)
Tap one result to re-roll just that piece (perchance tap-plugin / update())
Random first line with genre; plot generator with genre/twist (writingexercises, reedsy)
Download a generator as one offline HTML file (perchance.org)
verse_extra: Every result is reproducible from a link (?g=&seed=&n=) by default; Perchance needs a plugin and others have none
Works offline after one visit (service worker)
Haiku with exact 5-7-5 syllables and rhyming limericks
German interface from the browser language
